title: My Shadow Ran Away
targetPhonics: CVC short vowels (a, i, o, u)
skill_description: Practice reading CVC words with short vowels. 'Shadow' is a heart word learned as a whole.
author: FunBookies
summary: Sunny's shadow gets bored and runs away to have its own adventures. She chases it across the neighborhood until sunset, when they finally reunite.

sunny.name: Sunny
sunny.visual_shorthand: Girl (5) with wild curly brown hair, yellow sundress, bare feet, determined expression

shadow.name: Shadow
shadow.visual_shorthand: Bold black silhouette figure, stretchy and expressive, simple shape but full of personality

setting_context: Sunny neighborhood in golden hour light. Grassy yards, a big tree, a small pond, a friendly dog. Warm summer evening feeling. Long dramatic shadows everywhere.

story_bible.premise: A child's shadow comes alive and runs away to have its own fun, leading to a chase across the neighborhood that ends in reunion at sunset.
story_bible.setting: Suburban neighborhood bathed in golden hour light - warm grass, big oak tree, small pond, picket fences
story_bible.visual_style: Golden Hour Silhouette style: Warm sunset palette (golden yellows, soft oranges, dusty pinks, deep purples). Shadow is always bold black silhouette. World rendered in soft, hazy watercolor washes. Long dramatic shadows. Colors shift warmer as sun sets, building visual tension.
story_bible.emotional_arc: playful mischief → exciting chase → worry as sun sets → warm reunion

reference_prompt:
9-PANEL STYLE REFERENCE for children's book 'My Shadow Ran Away'

VISUAL STYLE: Golden Hour Silhouette - warm sunset palette, soft watercolor washes, bold black silhouettes for shadows. Nostalgic summer evening light.

Row 1 - CHARACTER SUNNY:
[1] Sunny standing: Girl (5) with wild curly brown hair, yellow sundress, bare feet. Hands on hips, determined look. Golden afternoon light bathes her. Her shadow stretches long beside her.
[2] Sunny running: Same girl mid-stride, arms pumping, hair bouncing. Chasing something. Warm orange light. Dynamic pose.
[3] Sunny kneeling: Gentle expression, arms open welcoming. Soft pink sunset light on her face. Caring, relieved.

Row 2 - CHARACTER SHADOW:
[4] Shadow standing: Bold black silhouette figure on golden grass. Simple but expressive - you can see attitude in the pose. Hands on hips mimicking Sunny.
[5] Shadow playful: Same black silhouette but stretched tall and thin, arms up in joy, clearly having fun. Mischievous energy.
[6] Shadow scared: Silhouette becoming faint and wispy, hunched over, reaching out. Translucent edges showing it's fading.

Row 3 - SETTINGS & COLOR:
[7] Golden afternoon: Grassy yard, big oak tree, picket fence. Sun high, warm yellow light, long shadows on grass.
[8] Sunset pond: Small pond with reeds, water reflecting orange and pink sky. Ripples, scattered ducks.
[9] Deep sunset: Big orange sun on horizon, sky in bands of gold, orange, pink, purple. Silhouettes of trees. Magic hour.

STYLE: Soft watercolor washes, warm nostalgic palette, bold black silhouettes. NO TEXT.

pages.text:
The sun got low.
Shadow got thin and sad.
pages.scene: Mood shift: The sun is now a large orange ball low on the horizon. Shadow has become stretched impossibly long and thin, its silhouette fading at the edges, becoming translucent. It looks down at itself with worry - hunched posture, arms wrapped around itself. Colors are deep orange, pink, purple. Long dramatic shadows everywhere. Melancholy beauty.

pages.text:
"I am fading!" Shadow cried.
"I want to come back!"
pages.scene: Emotional moment: Shadow reaching desperately toward Sunny, its form wispy and faint, barely visible against the deep sunset colors. Fear in its pose. Sunny kneels down with open arms, soft caring expression, welcoming. Deep pink and purple sky. The shadow is almost ghost-like. Tenderness and worry.

pages.text:
Sunny held out her hand.
Shadow came back home.
pages.scene: Reunion: Sunny and her shadow reconnected - Shadow is now properly attached to her feet again, solid and dark. They walk together toward home as silhouettes against a gorgeous deep orange and pink sunset sky. Sunny's hand reaches down to touch where her shadow meets her feet. Peace and belonging. Houses silhouetted in distance. Perfect golden hour ending.

Sunny in bed, moonlight through window casting a gentle shadow on the wall beside her. She sleeps peacefully with a small smile. On the wall, her shadow gives a tiny wave - still alive, still connected, but content now. Soft blue moonlight, cozy bedroom, stuffed animals. The shadow and girl are together.

parent_tips.before_reading: Look at the cover together. Ask: What do you think is happening? Why would a shadow run away? Have you ever noticed your shadow doing funny things?
parent_tips.during_reading: Help with 'shadow' and 'away' - these are heart words we learn as wholes. Sound out words like: sun, sat, ran, fun, big, hid, hop, dog, got, dip, wet, sad.
parent_tips.after_reading: Go outside and play with shadows! What happens to your shadow when the sun is high? When it's low? Can you make your shadow do funny poses?

comprehension_questions.answer: She held out her hand and welcomed it home
